block: PidCC (AC 800M), documented through the Pid01A unit
source: ABB 3AST001596D013 rev D (Pid01A, 2009) p.9-10, p.23: ideal PID, deviation in percent of range; ABB 3BSE041488-600 A (Binary and Analog Handling, 05/2016) p.120-124: G = Gain x OutRange / PvRange with Gain normalised and dimensionless, setpoint weight beta editable in PidCC; neither document states the unit of TI
caveats: Unit of TI and TD NOT confirmed by a document: check the PidCC page of the Control Builder library manual (3BSE035982) or the block's parameter help before use
Pid01A is the ControlIT unit around PidCC, not the AC 800M library manual itself
Gain is entered normalised (G = Gain x OutRange / PvRange is applied inside), so kc is used as it is, with no range scaling
Reverse action is a selectable setting, not a negative Gain
Setpoint weight beta is 0 for a discontinuous setpoint by default: set it to 1 (editable in PidCC) when an externally calculated tuning is applied
